description: This Java class defines ServiceEcaCondition, which represents a condition used in service event condition actions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for constructing conditions from XML elements, evaluating conditions based on context, and generating descriptive strings.

classes.name: ServiceEcaCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition for service event actions, capable of evaluating itself based on context and configuration.

methods.name: getShortDisplayDescription
methods.description: Returns a concise string describing the condition, with optional detailed info.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against the provided context and dispatch context, possibly invoking a service or comparing values.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the condition object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the condition's attributes.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another ServiceEcaCondition object based on attributes.
